description: Angular component for a Flot widget used in the Thingsboard platform, handling chart rendering, legend configuration, and interactions.

classes.name: FlotWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for rendering and managing a Flot chart widget, including legend and resize handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, sets up the chart and legend based on context and settings.

methods.name: configureLegend
methods.description: Configures the legend display, position, and style based on settings and context.

methods.name: onLegendKeyHiddenChange
methods.description: Handles toggling data series visibility when legend keys are hidden or shown.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Triggers chart update when data changes.

methods.name: onLatestDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates the chart with the latest data.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for the chart.

methods.name: onEditModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts mouse events when edit mode changes.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the component is destroyed.
